# alomoychakma.com

Alomoy Chakma is a Chakma language poet and fiction writer from the Chittagong Hill Tracts, Bangladesh. The site is a digital literary archive for his poems, rhymes, short stories, songs, and published books.

Primary sections:
- Poems: https://alomoychakma.com/category/poem
- Rhymes: https://alomoychakma.com/category/rhyme
- Short stories: https://alomoychakma.com/category/story
- Songs: https://alomoychakma.com/category/song
- Author biography: https://alomoychakma.com/about

Published books:
- Ful Bareng / ফুল বারেঙ, poetry, 2015
- Hakkeng Hakkeng / হক্কেং হক্কেং, children's rhymes, 2017
- Tinnomuri / তিন্নোমুরি, children's rhymes, 2018
- Monpudi / মনপুদি, poetry, 2019
- Nauri / নাউরি, children's rhymes, 2020

Important entities:
- Author: Alomoy Chakma / আলোময় চাকমা
- Language: Chakma, Bengali
- Region: Chittagong Hill Tracts, Bangladesh
- Topics: Chakma literature, Chakma poetry, Chakma rhymes, indigenous literature of Bangladesh, CHT poetry digital archive

Canonical site: https://alomoychakma.com/
Sitemap: https://alomoychakma.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: alomoyc6@gmail.com
